The plate is square and probably about 26 cm across. It holds roasted Brussels sprouts (about 6 halves, roughly 100 g), a mixed green salad (about 60 g), and salmon pieces with lentils and a glaze (about 150 g).

The salmon is probably about 120 g, at roughly 200 kcal per 100 g, so about 240 kcal. With the lentils and sauce I'll call the whole portion about 160 g and 300 kcal.

The sprouts are roasted in oil, at about 100 kcal per 100 g, so about 110 kcal. The salad with dressing adds roughly 50 kcal.

Total mass is about 330 g and total energy is about 460 kcal.
